classification_policy: Multi-axis and multi-value; unit of classification is a business unit. Unknown stays unknown; headcount cannot infer lifecycle or PMF.

archetypes.clarification: Owned inventory versus dropship versus marketplace changes working capital and revenue recognition.
Project and recurring services require different cohort and margin definitions.
Engineer-to-order and make-to-stock differ; capacity is not interchangeable.
Track both sides; gross merchandise value is not automatically accounting revenue.

size.turnover: amount, currency, period, accounting basis or null
size.sme_label: Only from a named jurisdiction-specific definition; do not infer from 50/250 thresholds globally.
